_comment: Replay fixture: a representative AssetScope agent submission for the GLP-1 obesity query, assembled from the verified ClinicalTrials.gov / ChEMBL / PubMed data. The last narrative claim cites a non-retrieved source id and is dropped by the reliability guard. valid_source_ids is the agent's citation ledger (everything it actually retrieved).

assets.mechanism: GLP-1 receptor agonist (acylated peptide, once-weekly subcutaneous)
assets.latest_readout: STEP 1 (NCT03548935): ~14.9% mean weight loss at 68 weeks vs 2.4% placebo (NEJM 2021).

assets.mechanism: Dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist (once-weekly subcutaneous peptide)
assets.indication: Obesity; type 2 diabetes; obstructive sleep apnea
assets.latest_readout: SURMOUNT-1 (NCT04184622): up to ~20.9% weight loss at 72 weeks (NEJM 2022); SURMOUNT-4 maintenance (JAMA 2024).

assets.mechanism: Oral once-daily non-peptide small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist
assets.latest_readout: ATTAIN-1 phase 3 obesity readout (NEJM 2025, PMID 40960239), ~11-12% weight loss as an oral agent.

assets.mechanism: Triple agonist of GLP-1, GIP and glucagon receptors (once-weekly peptide)
assets.latest_readout: Phase 2 (NCT04881760): up to ~24% weight loss at 48 weeks (NEJM 2023); phase 3 TRIUMPH ongoing.

assets.mechanism: Dual glucagon (GCGR) and GLP-1 receptor agonist
assets.latest_readout: Phase 2: up to ~18.7% weight loss; phase 3 SYNCHRONIZE ongoing (Diabetes Obes Metab 2025).
Program discontinued in 2025 after a liver-enzyme safety signal (Diabetes Obes Metab 2025).

narrative_claims.text: Tirzepatide, a dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist, achieved up to ~20.9% mean weight loss at 72 weeks in SURMOUNT-1 and is approved for obesity.
Once-weekly semaglutide 2.4 mg (Wegovy) produced ~14.9% weight loss at 68 weeks in STEP 1 and is FDA-approved for chronic weight management.
Orforglipron is an oral, once-daily non-peptide GLP-1 receptor agonist in phase 3, with an ATTAIN-1 obesity readout published in NEJM in 2025.
Retatrutide, a GLP-1/GIP/glucagon triple agonist, reached ~24% weight loss at 48 weeks in phase 2 — the highest reported for an incretin to date.
CagriSema combines the amylin analog cagrilintide with semaglutide and showed ~20-23% weight loss in the phase 3 REDEFINE 1 trial.
Survodutide is a glucagon/GLP-1 receptor dual agonist in phase 3 (SYNCHRONIZE) for obesity and MASH.
Pfizer discontinued the oral GLP-1 agonist danuglipron in 2025 following a liver-enzyme safety signal.
GLP1R (ENSG00000112164) is the primary molecular target of GLP-1 receptor agonists and a co-target of the dual and triple incretin agonists.
Tirzepatide is also approved as a first-line therapy for type 1 diabetes.
